purpose: Registry of every source the observation pipeline reads, so a consumer can re-collect or audit provenance without reading the package.

sources.name: Office of the Auditor General — local-level report API
sources.method: one GET, JSON response, no pagination needed at per_page=2000
sources.note: The provinces property is the roster source; reports and fiscal_years are not.

sources.name: Certificate Transparency search — crt.sh
sources.method: one GET, JSON array of certificate records; names extracted from name_value and common_name

sources.name: Local-body e-office directory (dcc-localbody-list)
sources.method: 76 paginated HTML pages, 10 rows each; one GET per page; English name, wards and website per row
sources.note: Primary attribution source: 753 rows, 750 with a website. Contains duplicate rows and some wrong or generic links, so every hostname is cross-checked before it is accepted.

sources.name: Wikidata Query Service — Nepali entities with P856 official website
sources.method: one SPARQL GET; P17 = Nepal, P856 official website, optional P131 district
sources.note: Secondary attribution source: 1,534 items including non-local agencies, so candidates are filtered by name, district and hostname agreement.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Overpass — Nepal administrative relations
sources.method: one Overpass query; boundary=administrative, admin_level 7 or 8 inside the Nepal area; tags only
sources.note: Corroboration only: 749 relations but just 5 carry a website tag, so it never contributes an attribution on its own.

sources.name: Kagaj curated owner seed
sources.method: internal curated JSON; each entry cites the source that establishes the owner
sources.note: Manual entity classification for apex hostnames whose owner is citable but absent from Wikidata P856. Kept empty until an entry can cite evidence.

sources.name: ipwho.is IP registration metadata
sources.method: one GET per public IP address; ASN, organization and country only
sources.note: Only global public addresses are queried; private and link-local addresses never leave the host.

sources.name: Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS resolver
sources.method: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA, plus _dmarc TXT per hostname
